🌅 Market News Digest
[Nov 9-10, 2026 EST]

🔥 Top Stories
• US-Iran tensions ease, talks revive — Trump said military action looks unnecessary; Qatar says mediation has momentum, while Strait of Hormuz tanker disruptions keep energy risk alive.
• Anthropic files mega IPO — Seeks up to $64.35B at a $1T valuation, with $26B cornerstone backing from Big Tech and a Thursday trading target.
• Nvidia faces spy-scandal fallout — Huang is under lawsuit/Congress scrutiny over alleged China ties; BofA and Wells cut back on $NVDA amid key-person risk.

⛽ Oil & Energy
• Brent slid below $90 and WTI to $85.79 as conflict-risk premium faded; US gasoline also fell under $4/gal for the first time since July.
• Iran-linked Hormuz disruption remains a flashpoint, with tankers reportedly hit/disabled and Gulf security forces on alert.
• ADNOC Gas said LNG flows via Hormuz are improving but still below pre-conflict levels.

📊 Markets & Macro
• Wall Street rebounded sharply, led by chips and tech; S&P 500 +2.35%, Nasdaq 100 +3.4%, Asia followed higher.
• Fed’s Waller kept December hike bets alive, floating 25 bps and even 50 bps if CPI runs hot; traders fully price a hike.
• Europe stayed hawkish too: ECB’s Lane and Kazaks signaled caution, with inflation still sticky and policy likely to stay restrictive.

🌍 Geopolitical
• Ukraine peace talks restarted in Abu Dhabi, with Europe saying any deal must respect sovereignty and security guarantees.
• Russia/Ukraine energy war continued: Moscow hit power substations, while UK said a backchannel with Russia is needed to avoid miscalculation.
• North Korea ratcheted rhetoric again; Saudi air defenses also intercepted Houthi drones/missiles.

🪙 Crypto & DeFi
• Trump Media bought 1,510 Bitcoin in Q3; MARA posted a $634M profit on BTC gains but sold coins to reduce debt.
• Coinbase warned of possible DOT transfer delays; Binance blocked MEXC-linked transactions after a FinCEN money-laundering designation.
• Peter Schiff renewed his anti-Bitcoin call as BTC marked five years since its $69k peak.

🏛️ Regulatory & Policy
• Australia announced mandatory AI safety/cyber reporting rules; Thailand moved to tighten data-centre regulations.
• Canada reimposed sanctions on 11 Iranian entities tied to nuclear/proliferation activity.
• U.S. regulators stayed active: FTC/CISA appointments, DOJ sued Lyft over disability discrimination, and Microsoft lobbied against a China transceiver ban.

🏢 Corporate
• SoftBank swung to a huge loss on AI/data-center costs; it also booked a $3.7B charge tied to US AI infrastructure procurement.
• Big tech chip names were mixed: NVIDIA under pressure, while AMD/Broadcom/Google backed Anthropic’s growth story.
• Consumer/industrial updates: Honda cut global sales outlook, Vodafone raised cash-flow guidance, Henkel lifted sales outlook, and BMW secured battery supply deals.
